name: git
description: This user's git rules: workflow (Conventional Commits, branch-per-context, merge and cleanup rules), enforced by a PreToolUse guard hook

guardUx.title: Explain this guard's decisions
guardUx.description: When the guard denies or asks, say why in plain words and what to do instead (the guard still decides; this changes only the words)

hygieneBand.title: Unpulled-release band
hygieneBand.description: A band above the prompt when local main or dev lag their remote-tracking branches (for example after a release), or have diverged; it never fetches or pulls

sessionToasts.title: Show the update notice
sessionToasts.description: Show ai-gent's update notice (printed by the session-start hook, which only the model sees) as a toast

releasePreview.title: /release-preview command
releasePreview.description: Declare /release-preview, which prints scripts/release.py --dry-run for this repository (it never releases)

bandCap.title: Most bands above the prompt
bandCap.description: At most this many bands draw above the prompt, chosen by priority (1 to 5); the rest are listed by /bands. A band that holds something is never hidden

bandsCommand.title: /bands command
bandsCommand.description: The /bands command: every active band above the prompt, with its priority and whether it is shown
